response.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating

assumptions.assumption: The per-film ratio rental_rate / rental_duration is averaged per film (AVG of the ratio), not computed as AVG(rental_rate)/AVG(rental_duration). Rows with NULL values are ignored by AVG.
Films with a NULL rating, if any exist, would form their own group. The verified data shows only 5 rating levels, so this should not arise.
